title: W. C. McLemore — business profile
text:
W. C. McLEMORE.

A few years ago W. C. McLemore went into the hardware business with only a small stock of goods. He soon built up a nice trade and in a short time he built a handsome brick with nearly three hundred feet of floor space. This building he filled from top to bottom with implements and vehicles, having sold in a job lot his shelf hardware. He has put out farming tools and buggies all over this country. So great has been his business during good crop years that many times buggies were never rolled into his house, but sold as soon as they were set up. This year has been more or less trying on all business, but Mr. McLemore has fared as well as anyone for he handles none but the best goods.
notes: Likely part of the same 'Rural Mail Dots' series as elk-80 (D. T. McMahon), given identical typographic style and format. No date visible.
